name: He (Helen) Huang
school: North Carolina State University / University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
title: Jackson Family Distinguished Professor
department: Lampe Joint Department of Biomedical Engineering; NREL based at NC State
fitReason: Substantial AI-method overlap beyond rehabilitation hardware: inverse reinforcement learning defines personalized objectives for an RL prosthesis controller using both human and robot states. This supports focused work in reward inference, adaptation or safe control evaluation.

physicalEvidence.summary: NC State’s November 2025 primary institutional report describes physical robotic-knee trials with five participants, comparing earlier robot-only RL tuning against bilevel IRL/RL incorporating human hip movement. It identifies the publication date as November 18, 2025, despite later2026 volume listings. A February 2026 report separately verifies a nine-participant, four-day powered-prosthesis study of body-image/motor adaptation; this is not a new RL algorithm. The full bilevel manuscript could not be retrieved, so algorithm/hardware specifics beyond the official report are not asserted.
